findings.description: F-001: tic-tac-toe-pro.png, the chapter's hero image, showed neither status nor score and was byte-identical to mid-game.png; its alt text claims a score of X:1 O:2 Ничьи:1.
findings.resolution: Fixed by the StringVar(master=root) repair and regeneration. The hero image now displays 'Ход игрока: O' and 'X: 1  O: 2  Ничьи: 1', and md5 comparison confirms it is no longer identical to mid-game.png.

findings.description: F-034: the 'структура' listing omitted cancel_pulse(), which 17.30 devotes a callout and a code block to, as well as on_close()/load_scores()/save_scores() from 17.27.
findings.resolution: Added load_scores(), save_scores(state), cancel_pulse() and on_close() to the structure block in build_31(), with short inline comments pointing at the sections that teach them.

evidence.summary: Learning objective and scope: Presents the finished Tic-Tac-Toe Pro as a whole, gives a four-part readiness checklist (model, rules, UI, architecture), summarises the chapter and bridges to mouse coordinates on Canvas in chapter 18.

The final program is a self-contained file with the listed structure and runs via 'python tic_tac_toe.py'. -- confirmed -- read in full and exercised through a 33-assertion behavioural harness; it is genuinely self-contained (stdlib only: json, tkinter, dataclasses, pathlib) and the __main__ guard is correct.

The same game as 17.6 now has a separate state model, highlighting, match score and full tests -- the same result for the player, a completely different internal architecture. -- confirmed -- both files read in full; the prototype stores state in button text with module globals, the final version has GameState, pure rules and render(), and both play identically from the user's side.

Every checklist item is actually satisfied by the shipped code. -- confirmed for all 12 after remediation -- board separated from widgets, explicit current player, explicit terminal state, invalid moves rejected without switching player, all 8 lines tested for both marks, draw checked after win, status always shown, adaptive board, working keyboard, short callbacks, pure rules testable without a window. The one item not upheld as shipped was 'победитель виден не только по цвету', which the code satisfied but the screenshots did not (F-001); now both do.

Chapter 18 will use event.x/event.y as the basis for drawing on Canvas. -- confirmed -- chapter 18 is 'Проект: приложение для рисования с Tkinter' and site/chapters/glava-18/index.html exists; the nav link resolves.
